ticket.title: Voice copilot: finish end-to-end validation
ticket.body:
Backlog; not currently dispatched. The old MCP connection/approval blocker was superseded by the LUX-127 delegated-read evidence. This feature is not accepted yet.

The current implementation uses browser Start/Stop audio and local Codex delegation with the saved ChatGPT login. Preserve invocation-scoped permissions, existing user files, and no paid delegation fallback.

Remaining: review and commit the preserved local changes, confirm the matching Studio connection, demonstrate a spoken edit and relative follow-up, and verify stop/cleanup. Do not start billed voice sessions during board cleanup. Preserve original scope amendments and evidence in ticket history, LUX-127, and tools/live-copilot/README.md.
